conditions.quote_anchor: you want to mark out the high and the low of this first 15-minute candle

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states exactly the instruction to mark the high and low of the first 15-minute candle.

conditions.quote_anchor: these are the only two levels that you need for this strategy

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote says only two levels are needed but never states that they define the initial trading range.

conditions.quote_anchor: As soon as the fair value gap prints on the 5-minute chart through that first 15-minute range

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote directly names an FVG printing on the 5-minute chart through the first 15-minute range.

conditions.quote_anchor: we need a mechanical way to identify this displacement

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote only asserts a need for a mechanical displacement method; it does not say the FVG is that signal or that it confirms direction.

conditions.quote_anchor: we're actually good to put a limit order right on that fair value gap

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote is the trader's own instruction to place a limit order on the fair value gap.

conditions.quote_anchor: as long as it dips down into that zone, we're going to get entered into the market

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote describes entry when price dips into the zone but says nothing about high probability or rebalancing rationale.

conditions.quote_anchor: you want to get to your desk right at 9:30 a.m. Eastern Standard Time

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote instructs being at the desk at 9:30 AM ET, which is the trading-day start the condition states.

conditions.quote_anchor: we're going to wait until the 9:30 to 9:45 a.m. 15-minute candle closes

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote is the explicit wait for the 9:30-9:45 15-minute candle to close, which is the condition's operative requirement.

conditions.quote_anchor: in order for the fair value gap to be valid, one of the three candles has to close outside of this 15-minute range

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states an FVG validity criterion (one of three candles closing outside the range), not the broader 'FVG must print breaking the 15m range' claim.

conditions.quote_anchor: we're going to put our stop loss on fair value gap candle one

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote places the stop on FVG candle one but does not specify the low of that candle.

conditions.quote_anchor: for our target, we're just going to go for a fixed two to one risk to reward

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states a fixed two-to-one risk-to-reward target verbatim.
